reviewer: Codex/GPT source audit (exact served model revision unavailable)
method: Two bounded local-model extractions followed by GPT review against the same frozen source packets. Reviewer saw the local responses; not a blinded or independent model benchmark. No accuracy or latency advantage for GPT is claimed.

findings.correction: The right branch enforces an upper bound only; the left branch enforces a lower bound only. A velocity of -100 with acceleration 1 and cap20 remains below -20 after a right-facing update. Caller assumptions could establish a stronger bound but were not in the packet.

findings.issue: Grounded condition omitted from general position-integration claim
findings.correction: Airborne X uses shifted xVelocity. Grounded X uses the missing slope function first, then the running branch suppresses displacement opposite facing direction.

findings.issue: Unsupported native-unit label and portable-C rounding assertion
findings.correction: The macro shifts by3 for divisor8. Four position subpixels equal one pixel, so the nominal scale is1/32 px per raw velocity unit per call; quantization and negative shifting still matter. Portable C signed right-shift semantics cannot be established from this macro alone.

findings.issue: Multiplicative operations rendered as additive/subtractive formula
findings.correction: Compute base speed times weather factor times stage numerator, then divide by stage denominator; apply conditional badge integer scaling, then Macho Brace divisor2, then paralysis divisor4; finally possible Quick Claw sentinel. Preserve every truncation site.
The product with base speed and weather precedes division by the stage denominator. Dividing the stage numerator first can yield a different result.

findings.issue: Quick Claw described as guaranteeing first action; citation only proves item parameter
findings.correction: Quick Claw replaces effective speed with UINT_MAX; higher move priority still wins. Threshold is floor(65535*20/100)=13107. Activation probability13107/65536 is conditional on a uniform u16 draw; random distribution and refresh schedule are outside this packet. Both ordinary holders share the same test.

findings.issue: Several plausible descriptions cite wrong or insufficient line ranges
findings.correction: Badge behavior is at4640-4645, Macho Brace4647-4648, paralysis4650-4651, and ties4728-4731 or4745-4748. RNG recurrence needs random.h plus random.c; header alone does not prove state updates.

preconditions: Two compared battlers use moves with known different priorities
actions: Compare priority before investing in effective speed advantages
knowledge_candidates.expected_effect: Higher effective speed alone cannot overcome lower move priority in this comparator.
knowledge_candidates.invariant: Do not generalize comparator to switch/item/action ordering without inspecting its caller.

preconditions: Both ordinary Quick Claw holders evaluated with the same shared turn number
actions: Reason about their activations as correlated, then resolve equal speed using comparator tie logic
knowledge_candidates.expected_effect: Avoids planning from an incorrect independent-roll model.
knowledge_candidates.invariant: No empirical calibration or win-rate improvement established.

preconditions: Pinned compiler/ROM confirms signed shift behavior
actions: Anticipate discrete position steps instead of assuming continuous floating-point integration
knowledge_candidates.expected_effect: Candidate control skill relevant to small velocity adjustments; actual input timing and benefit remain unknown.
knowledge_candidates.invariant: Do not infer per-frame acceleration, precision-jump timing or collision outcomes without callers and trajectories.

limitations: Two small packets do not measure whole-game extraction quality.
